site_metadata.bio: At the intersection of technology, artistry, and human behavior, I'm passionate about designing accessible and impactful digital experiences.

projects.title: AI Art Analysis
projects.description: Flask AI art critique app with RAG, CLIP ONNX, and API integration. Bridges the gap between subjective art critique and objective data.

projects.title: Dovekie Interface
projects.description: Open-source live-coding interface design for creative expression. Focused on intuitive parameter manipulation and real-time feedback.

projects.title: ARTS205 Portfolio
projects.description: Animated portfolio for Meditated Drawing course. Explores the intersection of traditional drawing techniques with digital animation.

projects.title: Electronic Textiles
projects.description: Concept art and 3D visualization for sensor network applications. Demonstrates seamless integration of sensors into fabric interfaces.

projects.title: Vinetality
projects.description: Tangible keychain interface providing physical feedback for productivity and well-being. A shape-changing representation of habits.

projects.title: The Wellesley Web
projects.description: Full-stack networking platform for tech students and alumni. Features user auth, database integration, and mentorship matching.

projects.title: Visual Arts & Collage
projects.description: Curated collection of digital illustrations and experimental mixed media. Exploring themes of identity and introspection.
